blacklistabilityReview.evidence: USDP (Parallel) is Possible, not Yes. Material deployments and shares: HyperEVM 0xbe65f0f410a72bec163dc65d46c83699e957d588 58.84%, Ethereum 0x9b3a8f7cec208e247d97dee13313690977e24459 26.80%, Avalanche 0x9ee1963f05553ef838604dd39403be21cef26aa4 12.60%. The token is an upgradeable TokenP behind an ERC1967 proxy (HyperEVM impl 0xe9b09cc151fcc7f6a1347098ed305b02f46b17b8; Ethereum impl 0x83de446e5076877263828e9120b0ea8b0bc0d0e4). burnSelf(uint256,address)/burnFrom(uint256,address,address) are `restricted` by a shared OZ AccessManager (HyperEVM 0xfD28f108e95f4D41daAE9dbfFf707D677985998E, Ethereum 0x94ea8800444017695345156319e96bdb1e355f7a) and are mapped to role 110 (getTargetFunctionRole=110; not closed). At HyperEVM block 48938877 and Ethereum block 26225011 the current role-110 members are all contracts and their code burns only themselves or the caller: FlashParallelToken (burnSelf(amount,address(this))), the VaultManager diamond's Redeemer/Swapper (burnSelf(amount,msg.sender); EIP-3009 auth path burns address(this)), SavingsNameable (no burn call), BridgeableTokenP (burnFrom(...,msg.sender,address(this))). No current member can name an arbitrary holder, so this is not Yes. Role 110's admin role is 10 with grant delay 0 and a live role-10 member, and role 10 also controls upgradeToAndCall, so an admin can grant itself the burner role or upgrade the token: Possible (ROLE-ADMIN-BURNER / admin-upgradeable). Sources: Etherscan v2 chainid 999 and 1 verified TokenP/AccessManager sources; https://api.etherscan.io/v2/api?chainid=999&module=contract&action=getsourcecode&address=0xe9b09cc151fcc7f6a1347098ed305b02f46b17b8

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex external-b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Parallel's production Parallelizer prices each whitelisted basket asset with external oracle and exchange-rate feeds and uses that value to calculate USDp mint and burn amounts, adaptive fees, and proportional redemption. The reviewed implementation exposes no borrower-specific debt positions, collateral health checks, or liquidation engine for USDp holders, so the basket valuation authority is scored at the top level without collateral-liquidation branch rows.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDp backing is held on four Parallelizer chains; the issuer documents a DAO-controlled LayerZero OFT Bridging Module across 24 chains, with required LayerZero Labs and Nethermind DVNs plus one of Horizen or Canary. Token authority() and role-110 gates do not by themselves prove absence of bridge controls. Existing native-issuance route rows require a deployment-scoped bridge-minter and transfer-rail census before their classification can be reaffirmed; the historical issuer-native tier is not a verified classification of the separate LayerZero rail.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20); Codex mint/bridge boundary migration (2026-08-16)

nativeExternalTransferReviews.rationale: The issuer explicitly documents USDp's LayerZero OFT native burn/mint transfer rail and DVN validation. October parameters name required LayerZero Labs and Nethermind plus one of Horizen or Canary, DAO-mutable daily/global limits and isolation off. This review binds the existing exact Ethereum native USDp deployment, not a new representation, and establishes only external-validation tier. It does not certify peers, effective controller/signing reach, immutable amount bounds, other deployments or whole-asset materiality; native issuance stays in Mint Authority.

controls.label: Ethereum USDp LayerZero OFT owner and mutable validation/limit authority
controls.capDescription: Exact BridgeableTokenP 0x78bb4882b77d74ad9b04ab71fe8e61f72595823c owns role110 to mint canonical Ethereum USDp on received LayerZero messages; source burns principal with the sending holder's allowance and can issue OFT receipt claims when credit limits are reached. Its owner is ParallelAccessManager. Current daily credit/debit limits are 250000 USDp and global credit/debit limits 1500000 USDp, not immutable economic caps: owner-authorized setters can raise them, with source MAX_GLOBAL_LIMIT equal to int256.max. Owner can also retarget peers and endpoint delegate. No direct upgrade capability, holder-seizure path or immutable whole-claim loss bound is asserted.

routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: Pinned Ethereum-side reads cover the 23 non-Ethereum networks in the issuer's current 24-chain inventory, using LayerZero metadata's exact native chain IDs/EIDs, including active PlumePhoenix98866/eid30370 (not deprecated Plume98865/eid30318). All 23 active peers are nonzero. This is the Ethereum outbound/inbound configured-peer census for that catalogued roster, not proof that every remote deployment or every possible unpublished EID was exhaustively reviewed.
routeChecks.attestorQuorum: Ethereum endpoint getConfig for both send and receive libraries on all 23 catalogued lanes requires LayerZero Labs0x589dedbd617e0cbcb916a9223f4d1300c294236b and Nethermind0xa59ba433ac34d2927232918ef5b2eaafcf130ba5, plus1of2 optional DVNs: Horizen0x380275805876ff19055ea900cdb2b46a94ecf20d or Canary0xa4fe5a5b9a846458a70cd0748228aed3bf65c2cd. This is configured network identity, not a signing-custody or independence certificate.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: ParallelAccessManager owns this exact immutable module. At the pin, setPeer/setDelegate select role10; pause/unpause/credit-limit/isolation setters select role20; role10/20 admin is role0 and canonical USDp mint role110 admin is role10. Ethereum Protocol Safe0x25fc7ffa8f9da3582a36633d04804f0004706f9b holds role0 with zero execution delay, returns5of8, and canCall setPeer/setDelegate immediately. Hypernative0xcd6f2a5d4dda89645ab463d38ca64b8a7309696f canCall pause/unpause immediately. Full Safe modules/custody and remote role graphs are not certified.
routeChecks.rateLimits: 250000 daily credit/debit and1500000 global credit/debit at the pin; isolation=false and paused=false. These readings do not prove no historical operational interruption.
routeChecks.unsupportedReason: The exact September5 pause/resume are confirmed Hypernative execute calls, but the issuer's September recap gives an undated same-day false-alert/no-Parallel-risk disposition without binding it to these hashes or module. Exact incident-state linkage and current conserved cross-chain/in-flight liability partition remain unresolved. No incident-none or material-supply percentage is authored.

controls.evidence: C03 Round3 research, 2026-10-21. Ethereum block26237389, hash0x475c39179c6a5450d9360ade51c7c5e1d6808cdfd07e15af6ff194ad0a23f26d, timestamp2026-10-21T00:29:47Z. Header hash matched before/after all state reads. Exact module and AccessManager runtime bytes equal the explorer-verified deployed bytecode at this pin. Owner/principal, active role110 mint permission, mutable owner control and current Ethereum-side23-lane peer/ULN census establish this scoped authority and claim-impairment path. Module _creditPrincipalToken calls native USDp.mint; _debit burns with holder allowance; _credit can leave OFT receipt claims when native credit is exhausted. Parameter/peer/delegate administration is directly callable through the observed AccessManager roles, not inferred from DAO branding. September5 pause and unpause were both executed by the issuer-identified Hypernative EOA through this exact AccessManager, lasting15:11:11Z–17:56:11Z; no mint-control/supply-integrity failure or loss is inferred. The current September recap discloses a false alert concerning dTRINITY and no Parallel/Frax risk, but lacks the exact date/hash/module join needed to resolve this incident factor. This is deliberately partial scope: no exhaustive root/Safe-module certificate, remote owner census, incident absence, liability-share attribution or zero-current incident inference. Historical profile/route review starts remain unchanged; the new control's date-only observation cannot admit before2026-10-22T00:00:00Z.
